SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN COALESCE(op.payment_installments, 0) > 1 THEN 'installment'
    ELSE 'single_payment'
  END AS installment_type,
  COUNT(*) AS count,
  ROUND((COUNT(*)::numeric / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER ()) * 100, 2) AS percentage_of_credit_card_payments
FROM order_payments op
WHERE op.payment_type = 'credit_card'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;
